_comment: Mined from Claude Code session de911604-fb3 (2026-05-03/04, 24 MB) via browse-chat-history. Each entry is one ralph-loop iteration the prior agent ran. Use as labeled training data for hypothesis quality — every REFUTED row saves a robot run.

iterations.change: T_partcenter dynamic r recomputed each tick from current TCP quat (vs static canonical)
iterations.expected: WEDGE_RECOVERY counter-torque correctly senses moment about part center
iterations.verdict: NEUTRAL — fix necessary but not sufficient

iterations.change: ORIENTATION FEEDBACK: WEDGE_RECOVERY T_cmd = -kp * tilt_err to drive EE face-down. engaged_tilt_max=1.5°, relevel_kp=2.0, wedge_Tx_max=0.4 Nm
iterations.expected: Active relevel during wedge breaks tilt-coupled stuck state
iterations.observed: tilt 1.5° too tight for actual demo (3.29°)

iterations.expected: Calibrated to today's demo tilt envelope
iterations.verdict: NEUTRAL — calibration kept, not the bottleneck

iterations.expected: Bigger lateral force = stronger lever to chamfer
Late-commit cases now register as success

iterations.change: State-independent GLOBAL SEAT detector — fires when z_drop≥20mm + |dz/dt|<0.5mm/s + tilt<5° sustained 1s, regardless of FSM state
iterations.expected: Bypasses FSM-bouncing reset of local sustain timer
iterations.observed: Verified offline on FAIL_INSERT CSV — would have fired correctly

iterations.expected: Less aggressive search avoids destabilizing peg

iterations.change: Reactive bump: find_hole_fz 4→8N, spiral_F 4→10N, recovery_F 2→5N, insert_fz 4→8N, gain 0.7→1.0, damping 0.5→0.3 (find_hole), 0.3 (insert)
iterations.expected: Higher force + lower damping = more responsive admittance

iterations.change: selection_vector: XY position-tracked in APPROACH/FIND_HOLE/ENTRY_SETTLE/INSERT (only WEDGE_RECOVERY keeps full force control)
iterations.expected: Lock XY laterally still while Fz pushes down — emulates operator's hand
iterations.observed: Peg cannot find chamfer when XY is position-tracked

iterations.change: Reverted selection_vector to all-force-controlled (admittance everywhere). spiral_F 10N, Fz 8N, global seat detector
iterations.observed: Ran 130s+ at z_drop=0.1mm — no progress, peg pressed on rim
iterations.verdict: NEUTRAL — admittance restored; bottleneck still present

iterations.change: Aggressive stuck detection: abort if z_drop<1mm after 15s. find_hole_max_duration 180→60s
iterations.expected: Saves test time + reduces URCap stress
iterations.observed: Aborts now fire fast — but pegs still stuck on rim
iterations.verdict: VALIDATED for stress-mitigation only — does NOT solve seating

iterations.change: spiral_v 0.0015→0.0003 (5× slower; each xy gets ~2s for peg to drop)
iterations.expected: Slower spiral gives peg time to find chamfer

iterations.change: INITIAL_PRESS phase: first 1.5s of FIND_HOLE = sustained 10N directed push toward predicted_xy, then slow spiral
iterations.expected: Mimics operator's sustained push during search
iterations.observed: Direction was AWAY from operator-demo direction (predicted_xy had 5-17mm CAD error pointing wrong way)
iterations.verdict: REFUTED — direction inferred from CAD was wrong

iterations.change: INITIAL_PRESS = fixed +Y baselink (5N, 1.5s) — matches operator demo walk direction
iterations.expected: Hard-coded direction matches what we measured
iterations.observed: Worked some attempts; still inconsistent — direction is hard-coded but seat xy is per-base
iterations.verdict: PARTIAL — confirmed the directed-push idea, but direction must be data-derived per-attempt

iterations.change: hole_xy_prior updated from contact xy (rim) to demo SEAT xy (+0.0341, -0.3635)
iterations.expected: Spiral now points at slot center, not rim
iterations.verdict: PENDING_VALIDATION — this is the v97 in flight at session pause

agent_meta_lessons.lesson: Tuning parameters before deriving control law from data leads to thrashing (16+ iterations, ~1 productive)
agent_meta_lessons.evidence: v85 / v89 / v90 / v94 all swept force/speed magnitudes; none worked. The breakthrough came from cross-run CSV analysis at session END.
agent_meta_lessons.action: Default to write CSV analyzer FIRST every iteration. Reserve monitors for state-transition events.

agent_meta_lessons.lesson: Direction prior matters more than magnitude
agent_meta_lessons.evidence: v95 (CAD-derived direction) failed; v96 (measured operator direction) worked partially; v97 (corrected seat xy prior) launched.
agent_meta_lessons.action: Algorithm needs a seat_xy source — either prior demo, CAD chain, or dynamic estimation from F_lat reaction direction.

agent_meta_lessons.evidence: Sensed F_lat is the rim's reaction (Newton's 3rd law); commanding force in -F_residual pushes AWAY from seat.
agent_meta_lessons.action: Use TOWARD-seat direction (CAD/demo-derived) for active corrections.

agent_meta_lessons.lesson: Locking XY via selection_vector breaks chamfer engagement
agent_meta_lessons.evidence: v91 — peg can't find chamfer when XY position-tracked. Operator demos have 4mm xy motion during descent.
agent_meta_lessons.action: All-force-controlled selection_vector. Don't 'optimize' by locking DOFs.

discovery_loop_seed_hypotheses: H201: At t=+0.05s post-contact, FAIL F_lat_base = 0.65N vs GOLD 1.09N (band [0.66, 1.57]). Discriminator at +50ms: is the algorithm applying enough lateral force in the FIRST 50 ms?

H202: At t=+1.6s, FAIL tilt_deg = 0.90° vs GOLD 1.56°. Lower tilt in FAIL means peg is NOT being driven into chamfer geometry. Tilt is a positive sign of progress, not a failure mode (within 5° envelope).
H203: At contact (t=0), FAIL fz_t = 7.20N vs GOLD 6.00N. Failures hit the rim harder. Approach velocity may be too high or contact xy may differ.
H204: 132 failure trajectories form a cluster in (state, action) space. Train a logistic classifier on aligned post-contact windows; identify which features matter most for discriminating early.
